Survival is two-family on fit: the facts refuter and both fit refuters (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6-Astra) must vote not refuted. In the nine layers whose first-round GPT-6 fit votes did not return, the missing vote counts as refuted, so no proposal there survived or counts as two-family agreement. The 27 proposals that no returned vote refutes are refuted by absence, not on merit: each layer's votes_note names them, their fit ref's gpt6 member is {missing: true}, and saturation_ledger.py (refuted_by_absence) and build_inputs.py do not count them as adjudicated. Each such layer is reopened (retained_failure).

The coordinator session's WebSearch cap (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION, default 200, across the session and every subagent) was reached at 04:10:13Z: 46 of this run's 200 WebSearch calls were capped, in 30 workers (the usage record's web_search), and no Claude refuter, follow-up discovery worker or critic search returned results. Every capped worker is a web_search_capped retained failure of its layer, and the critic's counts for every layer, so every layer is reopened (lane limit 10).
Reopen entries other than retained_failure copy the saturation report's current triggers at append time (this checkout's receipt staleness and the run's catalog-freshness artifact 36205743492).
